items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: Jon Hendricks, the great lyricist, told me that a lot of people think that what he does is fit words into a musical setting.

ctx.x: Do you have a title in mind before you start most of your songs?

That’s a good question. I often do. I often do. On the other hand a lot of times the title will emerge when some phrase becomes repetitive and you realize oh, well there’s the title. Everything I write I have to say starts music first. I’ve never written something out that looks like a poem and then tried to put music to it. It always comes from sitting at the piano playing something. And Jon Hendricks, the great lyricist, told me that a lot of people think that what he does is fit words into a musical setting.…

Oh that’s terrific. I had the privilege of talking to him and he also said that sometimes he got — when he was doing “Sing a Song of Basie” he said he was watching his hand write out the words like he was getting this —
